# COLR version 1 fixture

- Upstream: Google's COLR version 1 test glyphs (googlefonts/color-fonts), as redistributed by the
  `ttf-parser` 0.25.1 crate in `tests/fonts/colr_1.ttf`, with its licence `tests/fonts/colr_1_LICENSE`.
- License: Apache License 2.0; reproduced in `colr_1_LICENSE`.
- Font SHA-256: `0441303144c314d46ee12cf9742f1dd3fcbcb42700e7c51dba7b1b689c1dd1d7`.
- License SHA-256: `58d1e17ffe5109a7ae296caafcadfdbe6a7d176f0bc4ab01e12a689b0499d8bd`.

Unmodified. A colour font with outlines and a `COLR` table and no colour bitmaps, so the colour
emoji path can be exercised on a machine whose only emoji font is a bitmap one.
